title: Verification data and software for conjugate heat transfer in a sinusoidal air channel
description: Case-level numerical results, residual histories, and Python analysis code for a flat and a sinusoidal air channel. The 60 mm wave is compared at reference Reynolds numbers 100 and 800 on four common meshes with solid and transverse-periodic sides and two thermal correction stencils. Version 1.2.0 adds a wall-refined Graetz benchmark, phase-resolved wall flux and convergence diagnostics from a native SU2 thermal comparison.
